LegacyLink : NewLink`. `prepareSpecializedApp` with the describe-level `appPlugin`, a `createFrontendModule({ pluginId: 'app' })` holding the capturing `sign-in-page:app` override, and `createFrontendPlugin({ pluginId: 'test', routes: { newPage: newPageRouteRef, legacyPage: legacyPageRouteRef } })` with `PageBlueprint.make` pages `new-page` (path '/new-page', routeRef newPageRouteRef, loader rendering 'New Page') and `legacy-page` (path '/legacy-page', routeRef legacyPageRouteRef, loader rendering 'Legacy Page') and `AppRootElementBlueprint.make({ name: 'link', params: { element: <LinkElement /> } })`. Render `<PreparedAppRoot preparedApp={preparedApp} />`, a component declared in the test body as `function PreparedAppRoot(props: { preparedApp: PreparedSpecializedApp })` with `useState<FinalizedSpecializedApp>()`, `useEffect(() => props.preparedApp.onFinalized(setFinalizedApp), [props.preparedApp])`, returning `finalizedApp?.element ?? props.preparedApp.getBootstrapApp().element` (the same swap as createApp.tsx, so root elements stay mounted)., expect 'Custom Sign In' and `bootstrapText` are found during bootstrap. After `finalizedAppPromise = waitForFinalizedApp(preparedApp)`, the sign-in trigger in `act`, and `await act(async () => { await finalizedAppPromise; })`: 'App Layout' is found, `finalizedText` is found, and `bootstrapText` is no longer in the document. Before the fix the legacy row fails during bootstrap (the hook throws and the boundary renders nothing) and the new-system row fails after finalization (it stays 'Link: [pending]').

Before rendering: `api = preparedApp.getBootstrapApp().apis.get(routeResolutionApiRef)!`, `listener = jest.fn()`, `api.onFinalized?.(listener)`. At the start of the test body, a short comment says why the route sits under `app/root.elements` and why the test stays on the bootstrap render: page routes are not built on this path, and in a real app the app root error boundary replaces the root elements., expect Right after `getBootstrapApp()` (the startup initialize), `api.isFinalized?.()` is `false` and `listener` was not called. `renderPreparedBootstrap(preparedApp)` shows 'Link: []'. After `await act(async () => { await waitForFinalizedApp(preparedApp); })`, `listener` was called exactly once, `api.isFinalized?.()` is `true`, and 'Link: [/error-route]' is found in the still-mounted bootstrap render.

should signal route resolution finalization once across finalization when the error path follows normal finalization: given `let appRootCalls = 0`; `prepareSpecializedApp({ features: [noSignInAppPlugin], advanced: { extensionFactoryMiddleware(originalFactory, { node }) { ... } } })` where the middleware increments `appRootCalls` when `node.spec.id === 'app/root'`, throws `new Error('Finalization failure')` when that count reaches 2 (the normal finalization pass), and otherwise returns `originalFactory()`. Then `api = preparedApp.getBootstrapApp().apis.get(routeResolutionApiRef)!`, `listener = jest.fn()`, `api.onFinalized?.(listener)`. No React render., expect Before finalizing, `api.isFinalized?.()` is `false` and `listener` was not called.
